bio: I drink Coke and catch frogs.
My name is Vicente G., also known online as SharkPool, Shark-Pool, or SharkPool-SP.
I am a software developer, graphical artist, and musician from Canada.
I primarily develop with JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Java, and C, while also having experience with SQL, NoSQL, and a variety of other frameworks.
Most of my work revolves around web development, game development, and creating tools that make development easier.
I enjoy solving problems and bottlenecks, experimenting with new ideas, and constantly expanding my knowledge as both a programmer and a creator.

I began programming in early 2022 with little to no experience. Since then, I've built numerous projects, contributed to popular Scratch mods like Turbowarp and PenguinMod, and continued pushing myself to be a better programmer.
I'm currently studying Computer Systems (and sub-branches) in college while working on personal projects ranging from websites to games and other creative software.
Outside of programming, you'll usually find me making music, creating graphic designs, or exploring nature whenever I get the chance.
You can find my music and games here on Newgrounds.
